digest.component_or_area: binding_store.py module-size cap enforcement and peer-state extraction
propositions: binding_store.py reached 787/800 LOC, leaving only 13 lines before CI module-size gate fails, forcing urgent refactor to avoid breaking the next contributor

peer-state cluster (baseline + peer-parent functions) forms a cohesive 130-LOC concern with its own ADR-0026, absence semantics, and independent consumer set (outbound_field_diff, binding_walk, inbound_fields), cleanly seamed from binding lifecycle logic
extraction via free functions in new peer_state.py module preserves BindingStore public surface and all call sites unchanged (thin delegates only), ensuring zero test-double and caller edits
absence semantics (absent baseline degrades to local-wins, absent peer-parent to NO CLEAR) must survive extraction verbatim and be directly unit-testable without BindingStore construction
